不可得兼.chinese: 鱼和熊掌不可得兼，你只能选一个。
不可得兼.pinyin: Yú hé xióngzhǎng bù kě dé jiān, nǐ zhǐ néng xuǎn yī gè.
不可得兼.english: You can't have both the fish and the bear's paw, so you can only choose one.

不得其法.chinese: 他学了三年英语，可是不得其法，进步很慢。
不得其法.pinyin: Tā xué le sān nián Yīngyǔ, kěshì bù dé qí fǎ, jìnbù hěn màn.
不得其法.english: He studied English for three years, but he did not know the right way, so he made slow progress.

心神不宁.chinese: 考试前一天晚上，她心神不宁，睡不着觉。
心神不宁.pinyin: Kǎoshì qián yī tiān wǎnshang, tā xīn shén bù níng, shuì bù zháo jiào.
心神不宁.english: The night before the exam, she felt restless and could not sleep.

一本正经.chinese: 他一本正经地讲了一个笑话，大家都笑了。
一本正经.pinyin: Tā yī běn zhèng jīng de jiǎng le yī gè xiàohua, dàjiā dōu xiào le.
一本正经.english: He told a joke with a completely serious face, and everyone laughed.

沉鱼落雁.chinese: 故事里的公主有沉鱼落雁之美。
沉鱼落雁.pinyin: Gùshi lǐ de gōngzhǔ yǒu chén yú luò yàn zhī měi.
沉鱼落雁.english: The princess in the story was breathtakingly beautiful.

独一无二.chinese: 每个人的指纹都是独一无二的。
独一无二.pinyin: Měi gè rén de zhǐwén dōu shì dú yī wú èr de.

数一数二.chinese: 这家饭馆的菜在我们城市里数一数二。
数一数二.pinyin: Zhè jiā fànguǎn de cài zài wǒmen chéngshì lǐ shǔ yī shǔ èr.
数一数二.english: The food at this restaurant is among the best in our city.

绝无仅有.chinese: 这样的好机会是绝无仅有的。
绝无仅有.pinyin: Zhèyàng de hǎo jīhuì shì jué wú jǐn yǒu de.
绝无仅有.english: A good chance like this is one of a kind.

损人利己.chinese: 损人利己的事情，我们不能做。
损人利己.pinyin: Sǔn rén lì jǐ de shìqing, wǒmen bù néng zuò.
损人利己.english: We must not do things that harm others to benefit ourselves.

幸灾乐祸.chinese: 别人摔倒了，你不应该幸灾乐祸。
幸灾乐祸.pinyin: Biérén shuāidǎo le, nǐ bù yīnggāi xìng zāi lè huò.
幸灾乐祸.english: When someone falls over, you should not take pleasure in it.

力不从心.chinese: 爷爷想爬山，可是年纪大了，力不从心。
力不从心.pinyin: Yéye xiǎng pá shān, kěshì niánjì dà le, lì bù cóng xīn.
力不从心.english: Grandpa wants to climb the mountain, but he is old now and his strength is not equal to his wishes.

亦步亦趋.chinese: 学习别人的方法可以，但不要亦步亦趋。
亦步亦趋.pinyin: Xuéxí biérén de fāngfǎ kěyǐ, dàn bù yào yì bù yì qū.
亦步亦趋.english: It is fine to learn from other people's methods, but do not blindly copy them.

滔滔不绝.chinese: 一说到足球，他就滔滔不绝。
滔滔不绝.pinyin: Yī shuō dào zúqiú, tā jiù tāo tāo bù jué.
滔滔不绝.english: As soon as football comes up, he talks on and on without stopping.

桃李满天下.chinese: 王老师教了四十年书，真是桃李满天下。
桃李满天下.pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī jiāo le sìshí nián shū, zhēn shì táo lǐ mǎn tiānxià.
桃李满天下.english: Teacher Wang taught for forty years and truly has students all over the world.

省吃俭用.chinese: 父母省吃俭用，为了让孩子上大学。
省吃俭用.pinyin: Fùmǔ shěng chī jiǎn yòng, wèile ràng háizi shàng dàxué.
省吃俭用.english: The parents lived frugally so that their child could go to university.

婀娜多姿.chinese: 舞台上的演员跳得婀娜多姿。
婀娜多姿.pinyin: Wǔtái shang de yǎnyuán tiào de ē nuó duō zī.
婀娜多姿.english: The performer on the stage danced with great grace.

应运而生.chinese: 随着网上购物的发展，快递公司应运而生。
应运而生.pinyin: Suízhe wǎng shang gòuwù de fāzhǎn, kuàidì gōngsī yìng yùn ér shēng.
应运而生.english: With the growth of online shopping, delivery companies emerged to meet the need.

厮守终生.pinyin: Tāmen fāshì yào sī shǒu zhōng shēng.
厮守终生.english: They swore to stay together for the rest of their lives.

寓意深远.chinese: 这个古老的故事寓意深远，值得我们思考。
寓意深远.pinyin: Zhè gè gǔlǎo de gùshi yù yì shēn yuǎn, zhíde wǒmen sīkǎo.
寓意深远.english: This old story has a profound meaning that is worth thinking about.

一切就绪.chinese: 一切就绪，比赛马上开始。
一切就绪.pinyin: Yī qiè jiù xù, bǐsài mǎshàng kāishǐ.
一切就绪.english: Everything is ready, and the match starts at once.

囫囵吞枣.chinese: 读书不能囫囵吞枣，要理解每一句话。
囫囵吞枣.pinyin: Dú shū bù néng hú lún tūn zǎo, yào lǐjiě měi yī jù huà.
囫囵吞枣.english: Do not read without digesting it; you must understand every sentence.

塞翁失马.chinese: 这次没考上也许是塞翁失马，焉知非福。
塞翁失马.pinyin: Zhè cì méi kǎo shàng yěxǔ shì sài wēng shī mǎ, yān zhī fēi fú.
塞翁失马.english: Failing the exam this time may be a blessing in disguise.

狼吞虎咽.chinese: 他饿坏了，狼吞虎咽地吃完了一大碗面。
狼吞虎咽.pinyin: Tā è huài le, láng tūn hǔ yàn de chī wán le yī dà wǎn miàn.
狼吞虎咽.english: He was starving and wolfed down a big bowl of noodles.

避而不见.chinese: 他欠了钱以后，就对朋友避而不见。
避而不见.pinyin: Tā qiàn le qián yǐhòu, jiù duì péngyou bì ér bù jiàn.
避而不见.english: After he ran up debts, he avoided meeting his friends.

成千上万.chinese: 每年有成千上万的游客来这里旅游。
成千上万.pinyin: Měi nián yǒu chéng qiān shàng wàn de yóukè lái zhèlǐ lǚyóu.
成千上万.english: Every year, tens of thousands of tourists travel here.

依依不舍.chinese: 毕业那天，同学们依依不舍地告别。
依依不舍.pinyin: Bìyè nà tiān, tóngxuémen yī yī bù shě de gàobié.
依依不舍.english: On graduation day, the classmates said goodbye reluctantly.

如期而至.chinese: 春天如期而至，公园里的花都开了。
如期而至.pinyin: Chūntiān rú qī ér zhì, gōngyuán lǐ de huā dōu kāi le.
如期而至.english: Spring arrived on time, and all the flowers in the park came out.

自作聪明.chinese: 你别自作聪明，按照老师说的做。
自作聪明.pinyin: Nǐ bié zì zuò cōngming, ànzhào lǎoshī shuō de zuò.
自作聪明.english: Don't think you know better; do what the teacher said.

废寝忘食.chinese: 为了完成这个项目，他废寝忘食地工作。
废寝忘食.pinyin: Wèile wánchéng zhè gè xiàngmù, tā fèi qǐn wàng shí de gōngzuò.
废寝忘食.english: To finish this project, he worked so hard that he forgot to eat and sleep.

一门心思.pinyin: Tā yī mén xīnsi xiǎng dāng yīshēng.
一门心思.english: She is set on one thing only: becoming a doctor.

深情厚谊.chinese: 我永远不会忘记我们之间的深情厚谊。
深情厚谊.pinyin: Wǒ yǒngyuǎn bù huì wàngjì wǒmen zhī jiān de shēn qíng hòu yì.
深情厚谊.english: I will never forget the deep friendship between us.

死里逃生.chinese: 那次车祸他死里逃生，从此更珍惜生活。
死里逃生.pinyin: Nà cì chēhuò tā sǐ lǐ táo shēng, cóngcǐ gèng zhēnxī shēnghuó.
死里逃生.english: He narrowly escaped death in that car accident, and since then he has valued life more.

与众不同.chinese: 她的想法总是与众不同。
与众不同.pinyin: Tā de xiǎngfǎ zǒng shì yǔ zhòng bù tóng.
与众不同.english: Her ideas are always different from everyone else's.

心甘情愿.chinese: 为了家人，他心甘情愿地辛苦工作。
心甘情愿.pinyin: Wèile jiārén, tā xīn gān qíng yuàn de xīnkǔ gōngzuò.
心甘情愿.english: He works hard for his family, and he does it gladly.

无可奈何.chinese: 下大雨了，比赛取消了，大家都无可奈何。
无可奈何.pinyin: Xià dà yǔ le, bǐsài qǔxiāo le, dàjiā dōu wú kě nài hé.
无可奈何.english: It rained heavily and the match was cancelled; nobody could do anything about it.

眼见为实.pinyin: Bié xiāngxìn chuányán, yǎn jiàn wéi shí.
眼见为实.english: Don't believe rumours; seeing is believing.

耳听为虚.chinese: 耳听为虚，你最好亲自去看看。
耳听为虚.pinyin: Ěr tīng wéi xū, nǐ zuìhǎo qīnzì qù kànkan.
耳听为虚.english: What you hear may not be true, so you had better go and see for yourself.

十全十美.chinese: 世界上没有十全十美的人。
十全十美.pinyin: Shìjiè shang méiyǒu shí quán shí měi de rén.
十全十美.english: Nobody in the world is perfect.

星火燎原.chinese: 一个小小的想法，也可能星火燎原。
星火燎原.pinyin: Yī gè xiǎoxiǎo de xiǎngfǎ, yě kěnéng xīng huǒ liáo yuán.
星火燎原.english: Even a small idea can be the spark that starts a prairie fire.

夸大其词.chinese: 他说自己一天跑了一百公里，这是夸大其词。
夸大其词.pinyin: Tā shuō zìjǐ yī tiān pǎo le yī bǎi gōnglǐ, zhè shì kuā dà qí cí.
夸大其词.english: He says he ran a hundred kilometres in one day; that is an exaggeration.

举目无亲.chinese: 刚到北京的时候，我举目无亲。
举目无亲.pinyin: Gāng dào Běijīng de shíhou, wǒ jǔ mù wú qīn.
举目无亲.english: When I first arrived in Beijing, I did not know a single person.

四海为家.chinese: 他年轻时四海为家，去过很多国家。
四海为家.pinyin: Tā niánqīng shí sì hǎi wéi jiā, qù guo hěn duō guójiā.
四海为家.english: When he was young, he made his home wherever he went and visited many countries.

小心翼翼.chinese: 她小心翼翼地把杯子放在桌子上。
小心翼翼.pinyin: Tā xiǎo xīn yì yì de bǎ bēizi fàng zài zhuōzi shang.
小心翼翼.english: She put the cup on the table very carefully.

焕然一新.chinese: 房子装修以后焕然一新。
焕然一新.pinyin: Fángzi zhuāngxiū yǐhòu huàn rán yī xīn.
焕然一新.english: After the renovation, the house looked completely new.

乱七八糟.chinese: 他的房间乱七八糟，衣服到处都是。
乱七八糟.pinyin: Tā de fángjiān luàn qī bā zāo, yīfu dàochù dōu shì.
乱七八糟.english: His room is a complete mess, with clothes everywhere.

不自觉地.chinese: 听到这首歌，她不自觉地跟着唱了起来。
不自觉地.pinyin: Tīng dào zhè shǒu gē, tā bù zì jué de gēnzhe chàng le qǐlái.
不自觉地.english: When she heard this song, she started to sing along without noticing.

筋疲力尽.chinese: 跑完马拉松，他已经筋疲力尽了。
筋疲力尽.pinyin: Pǎo wán mǎlāsōng, tā yǐjīng jīn pí lì jìn le.
筋疲力尽.english: After he finished the marathon, he was completely exhausted.

顺其自然.chinese: 这件事你别太着急，顺其自然吧。
顺其自然.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ bié tài zháojí, shùn qí zì rán ba.
顺其自然.english: Don't worry too much about this; let it take its course.

恋恋不舍.chinese: 孩子们恋恋不舍地离开了动物园。
恋恋不舍.pinyin: Háizimen liàn liàn bù shě de líkāi le dòngwùyuán.
恋恋不舍.english: The children left the zoo reluctantly.

擦肩而过.chinese: 我们在街上擦肩而过，可是谁也没认出谁。
擦肩而过.pinyin: Wǒmen zài jiē shang cā jiān ér guò, kěshì shéi yě méi rèn chū shéi.
擦肩而过.english: We brushed past each other in the street, but neither of us recognised the other.

迫不及待.chinese: 收到礼物，他迫不及待地打开了。
迫不及待.pinyin: Shōu dào lǐwù, tā pò bù jí dài de dǎkāi le.
迫不及待.english: When he got the present, he couldn't wait to open it.

无所不谈.chinese: 我和她是好朋友，我们无所不谈。
无所不谈.pinyin: Wǒ hé tā shì hǎo péngyou, wǒmen wú suǒ bù tán.
无所不谈.english: She and I are good friends; we talk about everything.

不谋而合.chinese: 我们俩的想法不谋而合。
不谋而合.pinyin: Wǒmen liǎ de xiǎngfǎ bù móu ér hé.
不谋而合.english: The two of us had the same idea without discussing it.

不以为然.chinese: 大家都很担心，他却不以为然。
不以为然.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu hěn dānxīn, tā què bù yǐ wéi rán.
不以为然.english: Everyone was worried, but he did not think it was a problem.

我行我素.chinese: 别人怎么说他都不在乎，总是我行我素。
我行我素.pinyin: Biérén zěnme shuō tā dōu bù zàihu, zǒng shì wǒ xíng wǒ sù.
我行我素.english: He doesn't care what others say and always does things his own way.

栩栩如生.chinese: 这幅画上的鸟栩栩如生。
栩栩如生.pinyin: Zhè fú huà shang de niǎo xǔ xǔ rú shēng.
栩栩如生.english: The bird in this painting looks as if it were alive.

莞尔一笑.chinese: 听了我的话，她莞尔一笑。
莞尔一笑.pinyin: Tīng le wǒ de huà, tā wǎn ěr yī xiào.
莞尔一笑.english: When she heard what I said, she gave a faint smile.

胡说八道.chinese: 你别胡说八道，我根本没去过那儿。
胡说八道.pinyin: Nǐ bié hú shuō bā dào, wǒ gēnběn méi qù guo nàr.
胡说八道.english: Stop talking nonsense; I have never been there.

眉飞色舞.chinese: 他眉飞色舞地讲着旅行中的故事。
眉飞色舞.pinyin: Tā méi fēi sè wǔ de jiǎng zhe lǚxíng zhōng de gùshi.
眉飞色舞.english: He told the stories from his trip with great excitement.

漫无目的.chinese: 周末他在城里漫无目的地走了一天。
漫无目的.pinyin: Zhōumò tā zài chéng lǐ màn wú mù dì de zǒu le yī tiān.
漫无目的.english: At the weekend, he wandered aimlessly around the city all day.

左顾右盼.chinese: 过马路的时候，他左顾右盼，非常小心。
左顾右盼.pinyin: Guò mǎlù de shíhou, tā zuǒ gù yòu pàn, fēicháng xiǎoxīn.
左顾右盼.english: When he crossed the road, he looked left and right very carefully.

一针见血.chinese: 他的话一针见血，指出了问题的关键。
一针见血.pinyin: Tā de huà yī zhēn jiàn xiě, zhǐ chū le wèntí de guānjiàn.
一针见血.english: His words hit the nail on the head and pointed out the core of the problem.

轻而易举.chinese: 这道题对他来说轻而易举。
轻而易举.pinyin: Zhè dào tí duì tā lái shuō qīng ér yì jǔ.
轻而易举.english: This question is very easy for him.

全心全意.chinese: 医生全心全意地照顾病人。
全心全意.pinyin: Yīshēng quán xīn quán yì de zhàogù bìngrén.
全心全意.english: The doctor cares for the patients with all her heart.

相去甚远.chinese: 实际情况和他说的相去甚远。
相去甚远.pinyin: Shíjì qíngkuàng hé tā shuō de xiāng qù shèn yuǎn.
相去甚远.english: The real situation is very different from what he said.

彬彬有礼.chinese: 这个年轻人对谁都彬彬有礼。
彬彬有礼.pinyin: Zhè gè niánqīngrén duì shéi dōu bīn bīn yǒu lǐ.
彬彬有礼.english: This young man is polite and refined with everyone.

称兄道弟.chinese: 他们认识没几天，就称兄道弟了。
称兄道弟.pinyin: Tāmen rènshi méi jǐ tiān, jiù chēng xiōng dào dì le.
称兄道弟.english: They had known each other only a few days, and they already called each other brothers.

相提并论.chinese: 这两件事完全不同，不能相提并论。
相提并论.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiàn shì wánquán bù tóng, bù néng xiāng tí bìng lùn.
相提并论.english: These two things are completely different and cannot be put on the same level.

惟妙惟肖.chinese: 他模仿老师说话，惟妙惟肖。
惟妙惟肖.pinyin: Tā mófǎng lǎoshī shuō huà, wéi miào wéi xiào.
惟妙惟肖.english: He imitates the way the teacher talks, and it is just like the real thing.

忙里偷闲.chinese: 工作再忙，她也会忙里偷闲去喝杯咖啡。
忙里偷闲.pinyin: Gōngzuò zài máng, tā yě huì máng lǐ tōu xián qù hē bēi kāfēi.
忙里偷闲.english: However busy work is, she still finds a moment to go for a coffee.

全神贯注.chinese: 学生们全神贯注地听老师讲课。
全神贯注.pinyin: Xuéshengmen quán shén guàn zhù de tīng lǎoshī jiǎng kè.
全神贯注.english: The students listened to the teacher's lesson with full attention.

缘木求鱼.chinese: 不努力学习就想考第一，简直是缘木求鱼。
缘木求鱼.pinyin: Bù nǔlì xuéxí jiù xiǎng kǎo dì yī, jiǎnzhí shì yuán mù qiú yú.
缘木求鱼.english: Wanting to come first without studying hard is like climbing a tree to catch fish.

见钱眼开.chinese: 那个商人见钱眼开，什么都愿意卖。
见钱眼开.pinyin: Nà gè shāngrén jiàn qián yǎn kāi, shénme dōu yuànyì mài.
见钱眼开.english: That merchant's eyes light up at the sight of money; he will sell anything.

见利忘义.chinese: 真正的朋友不会见利忘义。
见利忘义.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyou bù huì jiàn lì wàng yì.
见利忘义.english: A true friend does not forget loyalty at the sight of profit.

下不为例.chinese: 这次就原谅你，下不为例。
下不为例.pinyin: Zhè cì jiù yuánliàng nǐ, xià bù wéi lì.
下不为例.english: I'll forgive you this time, but don't let it happen again.

可想而知.chinese: 他三天没睡觉，有多累可想而知。
可想而知.pinyin: Tā sān tiān méi shuì jiào, yǒu duō lèi kě xiǎng ér zhī.
可想而知.english: He hasn't slept for three days, so you can imagine how tired he is.

不翼而飞.chinese: 我放在桌子上的钱包不翼而飞了。
不翼而飞.pinyin: Wǒ fàng zài zhuōzi shang de qiánbāo bù yì ér fēi le.
不翼而飞.english: The wallet that I left on the table has vanished.

惊慌失措.chinese: 听到火警，有些人惊慌失措。
惊慌失措.pinyin: Tīng dào huǒjǐng, yǒuxiē rén jīng huāng shī cuò.
惊慌失措.english: When they heard the fire alarm, some people panicked.

龇牙咧嘴.chinese: 他的脚扭伤了，疼得龇牙咧嘴。
龇牙咧嘴.pinyin: Tā de jiǎo niǔshāng le, téng de zī yá liě zuǐ.
龇牙咧嘴.english: He sprained his ankle, and the pain made him grimace.

火上加油.chinese: 他已经很生气了，你别再火上加油。
火上加油.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng hěn shēngqì le, nǐ bié zài huǒ shàng jiā yóu.
火上加油.english: He is already very angry, so don't add fuel to the fire.

雪上加霜.chinese: 他丢了工作，又生了病，真是雪上加霜。
雪上加霜.pinyin: Tā diū le gōngzuò, yòu shēng le bìng, zhēn shì xuě shàng jiā shuāng.
雪上加霜.english: He lost his job and then fell ill; one misfortune came on top of another.

如愿以偿.chinese: 经过一年的努力，她终于如愿以偿，考上了大学。
如愿以偿.pinyin: Jīngguò yī nián de nǔlì, tā zhōngyú rú yuàn yǐ cháng, kǎo shàng le dàxué.
如愿以偿.english: After a year of hard work, she finally got her wish and got into university.

无理取闹.chinese: 孩子在商店里无理取闹，非要买玩具。
无理取闹.pinyin: Háizi zài shāngdiàn lǐ wú lǐ qǔ nào, fēi yào mǎi wánjù.
无理取闹.english: The child made a scene in the shop for no reason, insisting on buying a toy.

对牛弹琴.chinese: 跟他讲音乐简直是对牛弹琴。
对牛弹琴.pinyin: Gēn tā jiǎng yīnyuè jiǎnzhí shì duì niú tán qín.
对牛弹琴.english: Talking to him about music is like playing the lute to a cow.

理直气壮.chinese: 他没有做错事，所以说话理直气壮。
理直气壮.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu zuò cuò shì, suǒyǐ shuō huà lǐ zhí qì zhuàng.
理直气壮.english: He did nothing wrong, so he spoke with confidence.

思前想后.chinese: 她思前想后，最后决定换工作。
思前想后.pinyin: Tā sī qián xiǎng hòu, zuìhòu juédìng huàn gōngzuò.
思前想后.english: She thought it over from every angle and finally decided to change jobs.

如释重负.chinese: 考试结束了，大家都如释重负。
如释重负.pinyin: Kǎoshì jiéshù le, dàjiā dōu rú shì zhòng fù.
如释重负.english: The exam was over, and everyone felt a great weight lifted.

不可开交.chinese: 最近工作很多，我忙得不可开交。
不可开交.pinyin: Zuìjìn gōngzuò hěn duō, wǒ máng de bù kě kāi jiāo.
不可开交.english: I have a lot of work lately and am extremely busy.

重温旧梦.chinese: 多年以后，他们回到母校重温旧梦。
重温旧梦.pinyin: Duō nián yǐhòu, tāmen huí dào mǔxiào chóng wēn jiù mèng.
重温旧梦.english: Many years later, they went back to their old school to relive old times.

兴致勃勃.chinese: 孩子们兴致勃勃地参观了博物馆。
兴致勃勃.pinyin: Háizimen xìng zhì bó bó de cānguān le bówùguǎn.
兴致勃勃.english: The children visited the museum full of enthusiasm.

如影随形.chinese: 小狗跟着主人，如影随形。
如影随形.pinyin: Xiǎo gǒu gēnzhe zhǔrén, rú yǐng suí xíng.
如影随形.english: The puppy follows its owner like a shadow.

千言万语.chinese: 离别的时候，我心里有千言万语，却说不出来。
千言万语.pinyin: Líbié de shíhou, wǒ xīn lǐ yǒu qiān yán wàn yǔ, què shuō bù chūlái.
千言万语.english: When we parted, I had a thousand things to say but could not say them.

惴惴不安.chinese: 等待面试结果的时候，他一直惴惴不安。
惴惴不安.pinyin: Děngdài miànshì jiéguǒ de shíhou, tā yīzhí zhuì zhuì bù ān.
惴惴不安.english: While he waited for the interview result, he was on edge the whole time.

大惊小怪.chinese: 这只是一只小虫子，你别大惊小怪。
大惊小怪.pinyin: Zhè zhǐ shì yī zhī xiǎo chóngzi, nǐ bié dà jīng xiǎo guài.
大惊小怪.english: It's just a little bug; don't make such a fuss.

不足挂齿.chinese: 这点小事不足挂齿，你不用谢我。
不足挂齿.pinyin: Zhè diǎn xiǎo shì bù zú guà chǐ, nǐ bù yòng xiè wǒ.
不足挂齿.english: This little thing is not worth mentioning; you don't need to thank me.

天涯海角.chinese: 不管你走到天涯海角，我都会想你。
天涯海角.pinyin: Bùguǎn nǐ zǒu dào tiān yá hǎi jiǎo, wǒ dōu huì xiǎng nǐ.
天涯海角.english: Wherever you go, even to the ends of the earth, I will miss you.

垂垂老矣.chinese: 当年的年轻人，如今已垂垂老矣。
垂垂老矣.pinyin: Dāngnián de niánqīngrén, rújīn yǐ chuí chuí lǎo yǐ.
垂垂老矣.english: The young man of those days has now grown very old.

白发苍苍.chinese: 一位白发苍苍的老人坐在公园里看书。
白发苍苍.pinyin: Yī wèi bái fà cāng cāng de lǎorén zuò zài gōngyuán lǐ kàn shū.
白发苍苍.english: A white-haired old man sat in the park reading a book.

低三下四.chinese: 为了借钱，他低三下四地求别人。
低三下四.pinyin: Wèile jiè qián, tā dī sān xià sì de qiú biérén.
低三下四.english: To borrow money, he begged others humbly.

安贫乐道.chinese: 这位老学者一生安贫乐道，专心做学问。
安贫乐道.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo xuézhě yī shēng ān pín lè dào, zhuānxīn zuò xuéwen.
安贫乐道.english: This old scholar lived a simple, contented life and devoted himself to learning.

光明磊落.chinese: 他为人光明磊落，从不说谎。
光明磊落.pinyin: Tā wéirén guāng míng lěi luò, cóng bù shuō huǎng.
光明磊落.english: He is open and honest, and he never lies.

知足常乐.chinese: 奶奶常说知足常乐，不要和别人比。
知足常乐.pinyin: Nǎinai cháng shuō zhī zú cháng lè, bù yào hé biérén bǐ.
知足常乐.english: Grandma often says that contentment brings happiness and that you should not compare yourself with others.

东山再起.chinese: 公司倒闭以后，他没有放弃，几年后东山再起。
东山再起.pinyin: Gōngsī dǎobì yǐhòu, tā méiyǒu fàngqì, jǐ nián hòu dōng shān zài qǐ.
东山再起.english: After his company failed, he did not give up, and a few years later he made a comeback.

完璧归赵.chinese: 你借我的书，我一定完璧归赵。
完璧归赵.pinyin: Nǐ jiè wǒ de shū, wǒ yīdìng wán bì guī Zhào.
完璧归赵.english: I will return the book you lent me in perfect condition.

如虎添翼.chinese: 有了新电脑，他的工作如虎添翼。
如虎添翼.pinyin: Yǒu le xīn diànnǎo, tā de gōngzuò rú hǔ tiān yì.
如虎添翼.english: With the new computer, he works far better than before.

夜深人静.chinese: 夜深人静的时候，她喜欢一个人看书。
夜深人静.pinyin: Yè shēn rén jìng de shíhou, tā xǐhuan yī gè rén kàn shū.
夜深人静.english: When the night is deep and quiet, she likes to read alone.

班门弄斧.chinese: 在书法家面前写字，我真是班门弄斧。
班门弄斧.pinyin: Zài shūfǎjiā miànqián xiě zì, wǒ zhēn shì Bān mén nòng fǔ.
班门弄斧.english: Writing characters in front of a calligrapher, I am really showing off before a master.

乘风破浪.chinese: 希望你在新的工作中乘风破浪。
乘风破浪.pinyin: Xīwàng nǐ zài xīn de gōngzuò zhōng chéng fēng pò làng.
乘风破浪.english: I hope you go from strength to strength in your new job.

程门立雪.chinese: 他对老师有程门立雪的精神，总是虚心请教。
程门立雪.pinyin: Tā duì lǎoshī yǒu Chéng mén lì xuě de jīngshén, zǒng shì xūxīn qǐngjiào.
程门立雪.english: He shows his teacher the respect of a student who waits in the snow, and always asks for advice humbly.

狐假虎威.chinese: 他仗着父亲是经理，狐假虎威地欺负别人。
狐假虎威.pinyin: Tā zhàngzhe fùqin shì jīnglǐ, hú jiǎ hǔ wēi de qīfu biérén.
狐假虎威.english: Because his father is the manager, he bullies others on the strength of his father's position.

孟母三迁.chinese: 为了孩子上好学校，他们像孟母三迁一样搬了好几次家。
孟母三迁.pinyin: Wèile háizi shàng hǎo xuéxiào, tāmen xiàng Mèng mǔ sān qiān yīyàng bān le hǎo jǐ cì jiā.
孟母三迁.english: For their child to go to a good school, they moved house several times, like Mencius's mother.

愚公移山.chinese: 只要有愚公移山的精神，没有做不成的事。
愚公移山.pinyin: Zhǐyào yǒu yú gōng yí shān de jīngshén, méiyǒu zuò bù chéng de shì.
愚公移山.english: With the spirit of the Foolish Old Man who moved the mountains, nothing is impossible.

画蛇添足.chinese: 文章已经很好了，再加这一段就是画蛇添足。
画蛇添足.pinyin: Wénzhāng yǐjīng hěn hǎo le, zài jiā zhè yī duàn jiù shì huà shé tiān zú.
画蛇添足.english: The essay is already very good; adding this paragraph would only spoil it.

开卷有益.chinese: 开卷有益，多读书总是好的。
开卷有益.pinyin: Kāi juàn yǒu yì, duō dú shū zǒng shì hǎo de.
开卷有益.english: Reading always brings benefits, so it is always good to read more.

世外桃源.chinese: 这个小山村安静美丽，像世外桃源一样。
世外桃源.pinyin: Zhè gè xiǎo shāncūn ānjìng měilì, xiàng shì wài táo yuán yīyàng.
世外桃源.english: This little mountain village is quiet and beautiful, like a paradise far from the world.

津津有味.chinese: 孩子们津津有味地听爷爷讲故事。
津津有味.pinyin: Háizimen jīn jīn yǒu wèi de tīng yéye jiǎng gùshi.
津津有味.english: The children listened to Grandpa's stories with great relish.

落英缤纷.chinese: 春天的公园里，落英缤纷，美极了。
落英缤纷.pinyin: Chūntiān de gōngyuán lǐ, luò yīng bīn fēn, měi jí le.
落英缤纷.english: In the park in spring, flower petals fall all around, and it is beautiful.

虚怀若谷.chinese: 这位教授虚怀若谷，总是认真听学生的意见。
虚怀若谷.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiàoshòu xū huái ruò gǔ, zǒng shì rènzhēn tīng xuésheng de yìjiàn.
虚怀若谷.english: This professor is very open-minded and always listens carefully to the students' opinions.

心如止水.chinese: 经历了很多事以后，他已经心如止水。
心如止水.pinyin: Jīnglì le hěn duō shì yǐhòu, tā yǐjīng xīn rú zhǐ shuǐ.
心如止水.english: After going through so much, his heart is now as calm as still water.

随遇而安.chinese: 她性格随和，到哪儿都能随遇而安。
随遇而安.pinyin: Tā xìnggé suíhé, dào nǎr dōu néng suí yù ér ān.
随遇而安.english: She is easy-going and feels at home wherever she goes.

厚德载物.chinese: 学校的校训是厚德载物。
厚德载物.pinyin: Xuéxiào de xiàoxùn shì hòu dé zài wù.
厚德载物.english: The school motto is "great virtue carries all things".

大智若愚.chinese: 他看起来有点傻，其实是大智若愚。
大智若愚.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlái yǒudiǎn shǎ, qíshí shì dà zhì ruò yú.
大智若愚.english: He looks a bit foolish, but really he is a wise man who hides his wisdom.

相濡以沫.chinese: 老夫妻相濡以沫，一起度过了五十年。
相濡以沫.pinyin: Lǎo fūqī xiāng rú yǐ mò, yīqǐ dùguò le wǔshí nián.
相濡以沫.english: The old couple helped each other through hard times and spent fifty years together.

阳光明媚.chinese: 今天阳光明媚，我们去公园散步吧。
阳光明媚.pinyin: Jīntiān yáng guāng míng mèi, wǒmen qù gōngyuán sàn bù ba.
阳光明媚.english: It is bright and sunny today, so let's go for a walk in the park.

忐忑不安.chinese: 第一次上台演讲，她心里忐忑不安。
忐忑不安.pinyin: Dì yī cì shàng tái yǎnjiǎng, tā xīn lǐ tǎn tè bù ān.
忐忑不安.english: Giving a speech on stage for the first time, she felt very nervous.

说三道四.chinese: 别在背后对别人说三道四。
说三道四.pinyin: Bié zài bèihòu duì biérén shuō sān dào sì.
说三道四.english: Don't gossip about people behind their backs.

不顾一切.chinese: 看到孩子掉进河里，他不顾一切地跳了下去。
不顾一切.pinyin: Kàn dào háizi diào jìn hé lǐ, tā bù gù yī qiè de tiào le xiàqù.
不顾一切.english: When he saw the child fall into the river, he jumped in without a thought for anything else.

一日为师，终身为父.chinese: 中国人常说一日为师，终身为父。
一日为师，终身为父.pinyin: Zhōngguó rén cháng shuō yī rì wéi shī, zhōng shēn wéi fù.
一日为师，终身为父.english: Chinese people often say that a teacher for a day is a father for life.

不管三七二十一.chinese: 他不管三七二十一，拿起电话就打了过去。
不管三七二十一.pinyin: Tā bùguǎn sān qī èr shí yī, ná qǐ diànhuà jiù dǎ le guòqù.
不管三七二十一.english: Without a care for the consequences, he picked up the phone and called.

开门见山.chinese: 他开门见山地说："我想跟你借钱。"
开门见山.pinyin: Tā kāi mén jiàn shān de shuō: "Wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ jiè qián."
开门见山.english: He came straight to the point: "I want to borrow some money from you."

一蹴而就.chinese: 学好一门语言不是一蹴而就的事。
一蹴而就.pinyin: Xué hǎo yī mén yǔyán bù shì yī cù ér jiù de shì.
一蹴而就.english: Learning a language well is not something you achieve in one step.

惹是生非.chinese: 这个孩子总是在学校惹是生非。
惹是生非.pinyin: Zhè gè háizi zǒng shì zài xuéxiào rě shì shēng fēi.
惹是生非.english: This child is always stirring up trouble at school.

安居乐业.chinese: 经济发展了，人们安居乐业。
安居乐业.pinyin: Jīngjì fāzhǎn le, rénmen ān jū lè yè.
安居乐业.english: The economy has grown, and people live and work in peace.

难兄难弟.chinese: 我们俩都没考好，真是一对难兄难弟。
难兄难弟.pinyin: Wǒmen liǎ dōu méi kǎo hǎo, zhēn shì yī duì nàn xiōng nàn dì.
难兄难弟.english: Neither of us did well in the exam; we really are companions in misfortune.

笑里藏刀.chinese: 这个人笑里藏刀，你要小心。
笑里藏刀.pinyin: Zhè gè rén xiào lǐ cáng dāo, nǐ yào xiǎoxīn.
笑里藏刀.english: This person hides a dagger behind a smile, so be careful.

海市蜃楼.chinese: 他的发财计划不过是海市蜃楼。
海市蜃楼.pinyin: Tā de fā cái jìhuà bùguò shì hǎi shì shèn lóu.
海市蜃楼.english: His plan to get rich is nothing but a mirage.

厮守终身.chinese: 他们相爱多年，决定厮守终身。
厮守终身.pinyin: Tāmen xiāng ài duō nián, juédìng sī shǒu zhōng shēn.
厮守终身.english: They have loved each other for many years and have decided to stay together for life.

伶牙俐齿.chinese: 她伶牙俐齿，辩论时没人说得过她。
伶牙俐齿.pinyin: Tā líng yá lì chǐ, biànlùn shí méi rén shuō de guò tā.
伶牙俐齿.english: She is quick-witted and eloquent; nobody can out-argue her in a debate.

日积月累.chinese: 词汇量是日积月累的结果。
日积月累.pinyin: Cíhuìliàng shì rì jī yuè lěi de jiéguǒ.
日积月累.english: A large vocabulary is the result of steady accumulation over time.

雷打不动.chinese: 他每天早上跑步，雷打不动。
雷打不动.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎoshang pǎo bù, léi dǎ bù dòng.
雷打不动.english: He runs every morning, and nothing can stop him.

家常便饭.chinese: 对他来说，加班是家常便饭。
家常便饭.pinyin: Duì tā lái shuō, jiā bān shì jiā cháng biàn fàn.
家常便饭.english: For him, working overtime is an everyday thing.

一头雾水.chinese: 老师讲得太快，我听得一头雾水。
一头雾水.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiǎng de tài kuài, wǒ tīng de yī tóu wù shuǐ.
一头雾水.english: The teacher spoke too fast, and I was completely confused.

大汗淋漓.pinyin: Dǎ wán lánqiú, tā dà hàn lín lí.
大汗淋漓.english: After playing basketball, he was dripping with sweat.

有条不紊.chinese: 她做事有条不紊，从来不着急。
有条不紊.pinyin: Tā zuò shì yǒu tiáo bù wěn, cónglái bù zháojí.
有条不紊.english: She does things in an orderly way and is never in a rush.

知难而退.chinese: 遇到困难不要知难而退。
知难而退.pinyin: Yù dào kùnnan bù yào zhī nán ér tuì.
知难而退.english: When you meet difficulties, do not back down.

似懂非懂.chinese: 听了他的解释，我还是似懂非懂。
似懂非懂.pinyin: Tīng le tā de jiěshì, wǒ háishi sì dǒng fēi dǒng.
似懂非懂.english: After his explanation, I still only half understood.

知行合一.chinese: 学习要知行合一，不能只说不做。
知行合一.pinyin: Xuéxí yào zhī xíng hé yī, bù néng zhǐ shuō bù zuò.
知行合一.english: Learning must unite knowledge and action; you cannot just talk and not act.
